pāvacana.p: [ ပကဋ္ဌာနံ ဝါ အဋ္ဌကာဒီနံ ဝစနံ ပါဝစနံ။ သီ၊ဋီ၊သစ်၊၂။၂၂၆။ ပကာရေန ဝုစ္စတီတိ ပါဝစနံ၊ ပိဋက-တ္တယံ။ အပ၊ဋ္ဌ၊၂။၂၀၀။ ""] (na) Google Translate [pa + vaca + yu-. Pā + vaca + yu. Padhānaṃ vacanaṃ pāvacanaṃ. Pāsaddo cettha nipāto ""pāeva vutyassā""tiādīsu viya. Upa-saggapadaṃ vā etaṃ dīghaṃ katvā pana tathā vuttaṃ yathā ""pāvadadī"" tipi vadanti. Si

S: pāvacana：n．[pa-vacana，BSk．pravacana] 語，教語，経典，仏の語．
P: Pāvacana，（nt．） [pa+vacana，with lengthening of first a （see Geiger，P．Gr．§ 331）] a word，esp．the word of the Buddha D I，88； S．II，259； Th．1，587； 2，457．（Page 455）
R:
pāvacana：ပါဝစန （န） （ပါ√ဝစ်+ယု）
မြတ်သောစကား။ ပြဓာန်းသောစကား။ မြတ်စွာဘုရားစကားတော်။ ပိဋကတ်သုံးပုံဟူသော စကားတော်။ သာသနာတော်။
DOP: pāvacana n. [ BHS prāvacana; cf pavacana, S. pravacana], (a Buddha’s) teaching, instruction; the words of the discourses; dispensation; Abh 878 (suttaṃ ~e); Vin III 107, 4 (so Kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa ~e bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimantetvā …); D I 88, 8 (anuññātapaṭiññāto sake ācariyake tevijjake ~e); II 154, 5 (atītasatthukaṃ ~aṃ natthi no satthā ti); III 195, 19 (tattha santi uḷārā yakkhā nivāsino ye imasmiṃ bhagavato ~e appasannā); M I 488, 32 (evam ev’ idaṃ bhoto Gotamassa ~aṃ … suddhaṃ sāre patiṭṭhitaṃ); Th 587 (vijāneyya sakam atthaṃ avalokeyyātha ~aṃ); Thī 457 (anujānātha maṃ ubhayo pabbajituṃ dasabalassa ~e); Nidd I 40, 24 (idhā ti imissā diṭṭhiyā … imasmiṃ dhammavinaye imasmiṃ ~e …); Ap 51, 3 (pakāsite ~e; Ap-a 301, 32 foll.: tena Gotamena bhagavatā piṭakattaye pakāsite desite ti attho); 55, 4 (vitthārite ~e bāhujaññamhi sāsane); 495, 24 (evaṃ ~aṃ tassa arahantehi cintitaṃ); Bv 2:205 (supupphitaṃ ~aṃ arahantehi tādihi; Bv-a 128, 23 : pasatthaṃ vacanaṃ vuddhippattaṃ vā vacanaṃ pavacanaṃ, pavacanam eva ~aṃ, sāsanan ti attho); 7:25 (tassa ~aṃ sīlagandhehi dhūpitaṃ); Kv 286, 18 (bodhisatto Kassapassa bhagavato ~e okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo ti); Ud-a 268, 5 (dhammavinaye ti ~e); Ap-a 479, 17 (pakārena vuccatī ti ~aṃ, piṭakattayaṃ); Sadd 300, 32 (~asmiṃ hi garūhi aniddiṭṭhāni pi anekavihitāni nipātapadāni sandissanti); 604, 17 (bhagavato ~e akārappabhutī ekacattālīsa saddā vaṇṇā nāma bhavanti); 616, 15 (~e ca porāṇaṭṭhakathāsu ca); 617, 4 (esā hi Māgadhabhāsāsaṅkhātassa ~assa dhammatā); 752, 23 (padhānaṃ vacanaṃ ~aṃ).

pavacanīya.p: [ pa + vacanīya ] (na) (pravacanīya.saṃ) Google Translate (1) Action verb to speak. (Ti) (2) Talkative; he. (Mathematics teacher.)

R:
pavacanīya：ပ-ဝစနီယ （တိ） （ပ√ဝစ်+အနီယ）
အပြားအားဖြင့်ပြောဆိုဖွယ်သော။ ဆိုဆုံးမရာသော။
